en: Triangle: Switch view. Cross: Back. Up/Down on the D-pad or analog pad: Move viewpoint.
Choose an item category to view.
Change a registered character's name or icon.
Change the class of a character who meets the requirements.
An NPC's place in the list can't be changed.
Choose a character to view. Square: Reorder characters.
Circle: Spell List. Triangle: Character Details. Cross: Back.
Choose a character to delete. Square: Reorder characters.
Adventurers in an active party can't be deleted.
note: Koudouchuu = currently in a party (ctx).

en: Choose a character to rename. Square: Reorder characters.

Enter a name. A name needs at least one non-space character.
Enter a nickname. A nickname needs at least one non-space character.
